mapper.select: select system_code, system_name, owner_name, supervisor_name, status, remark, created_time, updated_time from monitor_system order by system_code asc
select system_code, system_name, owner_name, supervisor_name, status, remark, created_time, updated_time from monitor_system where system_code = #{systemCode} limit 1
mapper.update: update monitor_system set system_name = #{systemName}, owner_name = #{ownerName}, supervisor_name = #{supervisorName}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updated_time = now() where system_code = #{systemCode}
